linkPlacement: Quoted wikilinks in related frontmatter. Production topology includes frontmatterLinks; production chunker excludes frontmatter. Note body and embedding inputs remain unchanged.

cohort.fallback: If fewer than ten mutual-top-3, report shortage without changing filter.

assessment: Read both complete notes for every selected pair. Record technical rationale, concrete possible action and limitation. All human verdicts remain Requires human review. No precision or global usefulness percentage.
actionSelection: First cohort pair in frozen order for which reading both notes supports a specific contextual cross-reference. Add one frontmatter link in the disposable copy, then refresh and inspect classification. Do not change source corpus.
negativeSelection: First cohort pair in frozen order whose tasks or constraints differ enough that an unqualified link would mislead; if none, report absence rather than selecting outside cohort.
incompleteData: Separate controlled fault injection: withhold link metadata for first cohort endpoint, then restore; report as injected native test, not naturally observed missing data.
payments: No credentials and no external embedding/rerank/judge calls. Replay only hash-verified previously computed real vectors. Unknown input fails closed.
humanReview: Not performed by the agent. Session verdict controls may be exercised separately and cleared, with no user-quality claims.
